title: Round Table Foundation funded by Army, Navy and CIA
summary: Greg Malatzi tells of Round Table Foundation funded by Army, Navy and CIA, about 1949-1950 at Rockland, Maine, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: they were just like flocking to this place, basically giving him money to do research. And this was, yeah, '49, '50, very early.

plain: A researcher, Greg Malatzi, says that around 1949 and 1950 the US Army, the Navy and the CIA, America's spy agency, flocked to the Round Table Foundation, a research group in Rockland, Maine, and gave the man running it money for his research. He bases this on letters from the agencies to the foundation, and tells it to show that the military took this unusual research seriously very early on.
